floater.title: NEW VERSION OF CHARIS VIEWER
floater.string: Charis Viewer [VERSION] is out. You are using [CURRENT].
Charis Viewer [CURRENT] is no longer supported. Please update to [VERSION].
Opens the download page in your web browser
Opens the page of what's new in your web browser (the update file names no download page)
Downloads the new version from GitHub (you can go on using the viewer; the bottom right shows how far it is). It is put in when you quit, or with "Restart and update".
Closes this. You are told again at the next start, at the login screen.
You are told again only when a version newer than this one is out
RmlUi is not used in safe mode.
The page could not be loaded (the log says why). Turning off the setting PlusRmlUiWindows and restarting brings back the old window.
